name: hopla-web
description: HOPLA — web půjčovny skákacích hradů a nafukovacích atrakcí (Brno a jižní Morava)

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:art && npm run build:img

comments.runtime: The site itself has no dependencies. Everything here is tooling: the published output is committed and served as static files.
comments.python: scripts/build-artwork.py and scripts/optimise-images.py need Pillow (pip install pillow).
comments.browser: Playwright's Chromium is used to rasterise artwork and to drive the smoke test. Set CHROME_PATH to reuse an existing install.
